chinese: 彼得，请和我分享你最喜欢的故事。
english: Please share your favourite story with me, Peter.

chinese: 好的。从前，一只狮子抓住了一只老鼠。
english: Sure. Once a lion caught a mouse.

chinese: 它说：“请放我走吧！总有一天我会帮助你的！”
english: He said, “Please let me go! One day I will help you!”
The lion laughed and let the mouse go.

chinese: 后来，一个猎人用网捕住了狮子。
english: Later, a hunter caught the lion in a net.
The mouse helped the lion then.

chinese: 它咬破了网，把狮子救了出来！
english: He bit through the net and set the lion free!

chinese: 我喜欢这个故事。善心永远不会白费。
english: I like that story. Kindness is never wasted.
